correctness.rationale: The two degree-three terminals are intrinsic and the isomorphism type is their unordered triple of arm lengths. Three lengths ≥2 summing to 8 yield exactly the stated two subdivisions. Independent replay (python3 /workspace/reviews/evidence/theta_replay.py) exhausts all three choices per undirected edge: omit, orient forward, orient backward. It uses union-find to recognize forests and verifies the directed degree bounds. Once opposite arcs are prohibited, any undirected cycle in such a degree-constrained selection necessarily has coherent orientation, so this independently enumerates exactly the multipath faces. In order Θ224, Θ233 the f-vectors are (16,90,220,238,104,12) and (16,90,220,240,108,12). The listed pivots give 334 and 336 matches; a topological sort checks every nonempty Hasse vertex and cover, leaving critical counts (1,0,1,6,4) and (1,0,1,6,6). Integer column elimination with unit pivots on full oriented simplex boundaries gave ranks (15,75,145,88,12) and (15,75,145,90,12); each pivot can be split off as an integral unit block, and the residual zero block contributes no torsion. The boundary signs are the standard alternating signs, with the two orders of deleting each pair cancelling. The resulting H₂=0 forces the degree vector of the six 3-cell attachments to the Morse 2-sphere to be primitive. A GL₆(Z) basis change is realized by a homotopy equivalence of the attaching wedge of 2-spheres, so its homotopy cofiber gives a wedge of five 3-spheres as 3-skeleton. Rank H₃=5 forces d₄=0, and H₃ of this skeleton equals its π₃ by Hurewicz. Thus all 4-cell maps are null and the computed types are integral homotopy types, not just homology ranks. Frozen code was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Exhaustion concerns exactly the two specified graphs; no all-arm-length inference.
